messages.subject: Problem using withMathJax
parts:
Hi,

I tried to use withMathJax to display some equation but it didn't show the equation properly. I use shiny v0.12.1 on Windows. Below is a sample code which shows "Some equation $$\alpha+\beta$$" on my screen. Please help. Thanks!

# In ui.R file:

library(shiny)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
    sidebarPanel(),
    mainPanel(
        withMathJax(helpText("Some equation $$\\alpha+\\beta$$"))
    )
))

# In server.R file:
library(shiny)

shinyServer(
    function(input, output, clientData, session) {
    }
)
